name: Erioneuron
look_here_first: HAIRY WOOLLYGRASS: low perennial dryland bunchgrass with compact woolly-looking flowering clusters composed of several small overlapping spikelets. Look at the obvious silky white hairs on bracts with 10× magnification, then check glume and lemma details to separate other short tuft grasses. The original project owner's private-rights image is NOT used in the public genus lesson.
